body:
Updates all user-facing and package-level branding from the old ``hiero-cli-pqc`` / ``cli-anything-hiero-pqc`` naming to ``gridera-scan`` / ``gridera-scan-cli``.

Changes include:
- README rewritten with GRIDERA branding and command examples
- ``setup.py`` package name, URL, console scripts, and keywords updated
- CLI help text, docstrings, and info command updated
- Report/audit generator metadata updated
- Web demo page and API route updated
- Unit test docstring updated

Note: the internal Python package path ``cli_anything.hiero_pqc`` is intentionally left unchanged to avoid breaking imports. Only public-facing names are updated in this pass.
title: Rebrand hiero-cli-pqc → GRIDERA Scan CLI
